verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Invoicing generating AI insights or suggestions from user data inside the product. The MCP server lets external AI agents call the Stripe API, which is a different capability. Automatic reconciliation and CSV export are adjacent features, not AI-generated insights. As a SaaS billing product, in-product AI insights are a fair axis, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
